settlement.assetForm: issuer-native tokens only; no bridged or wrapped variants
settlement.availabilityCondition: Only after Bemjamin and the requester have a written agreement on scope and price.
warnings: Never send before written scope and price confirmation.
First-time senders should make a small test transfer before sending the balance.
Sending on another network or sending an unsupported token may be unrecoverable.
Payment does not expand the agreed scope.

offers.scope: One reported agent or automation failure.
offers.acceptance: A clean checkout reruns the declared check.

offers.scope: One reproducible failure in one bounded workflow.
offers.acceptance: Declared tests pass and the report names limitations and non-claims.

offers.scope: One named authorization, delegation, receipt, scheduler, or side-effect boundary.
offers.acceptance: Every verdict is traceable to one named rule.

offers.scope: One small authorized agent/tool integration path.
offers.acceptance: Fresh local execution matches the documented outcomes.

offers.scope: One static interactive explanation or compact technical landing using supplied facts and existing assets.
offers.acceptance: The build passes and agreed public routes return successfully.

excluded: full penetration tests or compliance certification
guarantees of security, revenue, uptime, business outcomes, or bug discovery
required_intake_fields: public or safely redacted repository or artifact
